svg.title: WPA2 versus WPA3 Practical Security Differences
svg.desc: Comparison panel highlighting practical security differences between WPA2 and WPA3, including handshake protection, PMF, and brute-force resistance.
svg.text: WPA2 vs WPA3: What Changes in Practice
• PSK model vulnerable to offline cracking after handshake capture
• Shared secret creates lateral trust between devices
• Strong only when passwords are long and unique
• Upgrade inertia keeps weaker configurations alive
Operational risk: weak passphrases and mixed-mode drift
• SAE improves resistance to offline dictionary attacks
• Better resilience to deauthentication abuse patterns
• Enterprise mode aligns with strong 802.1X identity controls
• Strongest when paired with certificate lifecycle discipline
Operational win: stronger defaults with less user dependency
CISSP lens: choose migration pace by asset criticality, compatibility constraints, and threat exposure.
